articles.title: As SpaceX IPO nears, traders think it's a near-certainty Musk becomes the first trillionaire
articles.description: With buzz about a record-shattering IPO for SpaceX, traders are confident Elon Musk will advance to trillionaire status before 2027.

articles.title: SpaceX skeptics have added reason for concern after Musk comments diverge from IPO filing
articles.description: In a post on X, Elon Musk offered details about SpaceX's deal with Anthropic that weren't included in the company's IPO prospectus.

articles.title: Mother-in-law of Indian bride whose death set off media frenzy arrested
articles.description: Twisha Sharma's death on 12 May has sparked rival claims of murder and suicide and dominated headlines.

articles.title: EU fines Temu €200m for allowing sale of illegal products
articles.description: The European Commission says the Chinese-owned online retailer failed to take account of risks from baby toys and faulty chargers sold on its platform.

articles.title: Paul McCartney on playing guitar with Paul Mescal: 'He knew it better than I did!'
articles.description: The music legend on delivering "memory songs" for his 20th solo album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane - and why he's intrigued by the new Beatles biopics.
